accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p:
This collection consists primarily of maps showing property holdings of the Rockefeller family and surrounding land in the Pocantico Hills region of Westchester County, New York. Maps date from the late 1920s to the early 1980s, with the bulk of materials dating from the 1960s and 1970s. The collection includes maps depicting ownership and property lines, topographical features, roads, building and landscaping plans, municipal utilities, and zoning, as well as a few architectural plans for actual or proposed structures within the areas shown. Many maps and plans were created as studies or proposals for potential property development and construction projects or land ownership transfers, which may or may not have been carried out.
Most maps were created by individuals or teams of architects and surveyors employed by the Rockefeller family, though some official maps produced by federal, state, and local government entities are included in the collection. Some of these officially published maps may be annotated with information pertaining to specific projects or proposals.
Materials in this collection are in overall good condition. Due to their size, most of the maps have been rolled for long-term storage, and in general paper is reasonably strong and intact for its age. A few items are in more delicate condition, and may have brittle or discolored paper, tears, areas of loss, and/or repairs with adhesive.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The Rockefeller Property Drawings are arranged by creator. The accompanying index cards are located in a series at the end of the collection.
